MOIN MEHRAJ


Visual Media & Film-Making Professional


+91 9622419832


moeeenmehraj@gmail.com


Gurgaon, India


SUMMARY


Creative and detail-oriented filmmaker with a comprehensive background in Visual media and Film-
Making including hands-on expertise in cinematography, editing, direction and content 
management from concept to final delivery. Adept at transforming narratives and life experiences 
into compelling visual stories that connect with diverse audiences across cultures and digital 
platforms. Proven ability to lead shoots, manage teams and deliver polished visual assets for social 
media, advertising and PR. Committed to continuous learning and innovative storytelling with a 
passion for empowering voices and sharing diverse stories, cultures and experiences impactful film 
work. Actively engaged in the film and visual media community with a strong professional network 
of 836 followers and 500+ connections in the industry.






EXPERIENCE


11/2024 - Present
Visual Content Lead 
ELIVAAS


Gurgaon


A tech-driven luxury villa and apartment management company offering end-to-end 
hospitality solutions and exceptional guest experiences.


	•
Led all aspects of visual content creation across 50+ projects, including 
conceptualization, photography, videography shoots and end-to-end editing, ensuring 
high-quality and cohesive visual storytelling.



	•
Executed over 80 shoots including more than 35 property photoshoots and 45 diverse 
shoots ranging from significant corporate offsites to ad campaign productions, 
ensuring pivotal moments were artfully preserved.



	•
Produced 20+ multi-platform campaigns from inception to deployment across Meta, 
YouTube and Google generating millions of views, including a top performing YouTube 
campaign with over 213K views driving substantial revenue through B2C lead 
generation, with select campaigns earning additional PR coverage.



	•
Created compelling social media content, boosting brand presence across digital 
platforms and contributing to a 233% follower growth (from 30K to 100K) over 11 
months with individual posts reaching up to 899K views.



	•
Produced versatile visual assets showcased across property brochures, home guides, 
the company website, major OTA platforms and social media channels including 
Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other key digital platforms.






Freelance Photographer/Videographer & Video 
Editor


08/2023 - Present
	•
Led all aspects of production from concept to post-production for 40+ projects, 
delivering tailored photography and videography services that improved client 
engagement and satisfaction by an estimated 65-75% based on repeat business and 
positive feedback.



	•
Crafted visual stories for diverse clients contributing to a 500% increase in social 
media followers significantly enhancing their digital presence.



	•
Partnered with clients to ensure alignment with brand messaging and objectives, 
producing engaging content for social media, advertising and promotional use.



	•
Applied expertise in cinematography, lighting and editing tools to produce polished 
visual assets.



	•
Adapted creative approaches to meet varying project requirements and styles.






Videographer | Internship


04/2024 - 07/2024
Coding Ninjas


Gurgaon


An online education platform specializing in coding and technology skills development 
through practical training.


	•
Executed 30+ in-studio and on-location shoots, collaborating closely with the content 
team on creative video concepts.



	•
Contributed to ad campaigns with a combined viewership exceeding 330K reaching an 
estimated learner audience of over 50,000 based on platform engagement and user 
growth metrics.



	•
Coordinated shoot schedules and led pre-production tasks, including set design, 
lighting, and camera setup.



	•
Utilized storyboard analysis to ensure alignment with creative vision and content 
goals.






Cinematographer and Editor | Internship


01/2023 - 03/2023
Parallel Productions


Bangalore


A production house focusing on various aspects of film production.


	•
Engaged in all stages of production for over four film projects contributing across pre-
production, production and post-production to deliver quality content under dynamic 
working conditions.



	•
Worked closely with supervisors to incorporate feedback and elevate project quality.



	•
Developed expertise in camera lens selection, manipulation, lighting techniques and 
set design.



	•
Contributed to teamwork skills essential for successful production collaboration.








SOCIAL MEDIA


Facebook


MoinMehraj




Instagram


@kyathaam




Vimeo


MoinMehraj




LinkedIn


MoinMehraj






HONOR & AWARD


First Runner-up Short Film


Awarded First Runner-up for short film 'HIJR' 
among 50+ entries at Harmony tGELF 2020.






TECHNICAL SKILLS



Adobe Premiere Pro Final Cut Pro X
DaVinci Resolve Photoshop Lightroom
Screenwriting Software Microsoft Office
ElevenLabs    NanoBanana
CORE SKILLS



Narrative/Visual Storytelling Filmmaking
Cinematography Camera Operation
Video Production Cinematic Lighting Techniques
Photo Editing Media Production
Digital Marketing Project Management
Leadership Communication Problem Solving
Teamwork Conflict Resolution Critical Thinking
Decision Making Time Management
Public Speaking Versatility and Adaptability
Ability to Work Under Pressure
Delivering Quality Results
HOBBIES & INTERESTS


Cinema Enthusiast


Passionate about watching films and 
documentaries to explore storytelling 
techniques and film history.




Reading


Engage with novels and biographies of 
filmmakers to enhance creative skills and 
deepen knowledge of the craft.




Photography


Photographing street, travel and portraiture 
for storytelling to create powerful visual 
narratives.

EXPERIENCE


Multimedia Intern | Internship


12/2021 - 02/2022
Mountain Ink


Srinagar


An online and monthly print magazine that explores narrative journalism through 
compelling stories and diverse perspectives.


	•
Gained hands on experience in audio-visual content production aligned with the 
editorial vision.



	•
Assisted in scripting, shooting, and editing engaging multimedia content to produce 
compelling stories and footage.



	•
Developed original story ideas for ground reports and in-house multimedia projects, 
contributing to diverse narrative formats.








EDUCATION


B.Voc. Visual Media and Film-Making


08/2020 - 08/2023
St. Joseph's College (Autonomous), Bangalore


	•
Practical oriented program combining technical skills and creative artistry in 
filmmaking, covering editing, cinematography, scriptwriting, direction and production 
management.



	•
Trained by experienced professors and industry experts, gaining in-depth knowledge of 
filmmaking’s technical and ethical aspects.



	•
Participated as a volunteer at Rushes National Film Festival (RNFF) 2022 supporting 
event coordination, attendee assistance and gaining exposure to film screenings and 
industry workshops.



	•
Delivered multiple final projects including short films, ad films, music videos, 
documentaries and original scripts.




Grade: First Division


7.2


 / 
10





Matriculation & Intermediate, Humanities


03/2013 - 03/2020
Delhi Public School, Budgam


	•
Awarded First Runner-up among 50+ entries for the short film “HIJR” at Harmony 
tGELF 2020.



	•
Actively participated in documentary projects and workshops on photo and video 
editing, as well as various local and national competitions.



	•
Contributed to documentary projects and a short film focused on disaster 
management.



	•
Conducted workshops on photo and video editing, sharing technical knowledge with 
peers.



	•
Represented school as an International Press Delegate at IIMUN 2018 and participated 
in the Inter-DPS Documentary Making Competition.



	•
Volunteered in diverse cultural activities, including theatre, language, literature, 
Kashmiri classical music, culture, heritage, and scriptwriting.




Grade: A


8.4


 / 
10







LANGUAGES


English


Native




Urdu


Proficient




Kashmiri


Native




Hindi


Proficient






HOBBIES & INTERESTS


Travel & Cultural Exploration


Embracing different cultures and traveling for 
diverse landscapes for photography and 
films.




Cooking


Enjoy cooking as a creative outlet and a way 
to appreciate and perfect traditional Kashmiri 
cuisine using it as a mindful break and 
cultural expression.






SELECT PROJECTS


Chasing Silver Halides | Documentary


04/2023
Created a documentary exploring traditional 
cyanotype printing techniques, emphasizing the 
artistic heritage and modern relevance of 
alternative photography.




Chaap Tilak | Fashion Film


07/2022
Crafted an experimental fashion film blending 
traditional art with modern fashion aesthetics 
highlighting creative visual storytelling.
